<style>
/* -2 product page (product.muto-nad-45): Artah-style buy box.
   Scoped to this template only (this block lives in the template). */

/* ---- Title block ---- */
html body .mc .mc__eyebrow{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.12em}
html body .mc .mc__buy-title{font-size:clamp(30px,3.2vw,46px);line-height:.95;margin-top:6px}

html body .mc .mc__buy-text p:first-child{font-size:18px;line-height:1.35;padding-bottom:14px;margin-bottom:14px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--mc-ink-alt,#242223);color:var(--mc-ink-alt,#242223)}
html body .mc .mc__buy-text p:first-child strong{font-weight:500}
html body .mc .mc__buy-text > * + *{margin-top:10px}
html body .mc .mc__buy-text a[href="#whats-inside"]{color:rgba(36,34,35,.7);font-weight:500;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}

/* ---- Benefits: two columns with rules, like a spec list ---- */
html body .mc .mc__buy-points{margin-top:22px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;column-gap:28px}
html body .mc .mc__buy-points::before{content:"Benefits";grid-column:1/-1;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:rgba(36,34,35,.6);padding-bottom:8px}

html body .mc .mc__point::before{display:none}
/* "Choose your plan", with a rule either side */
html body .mc .mc__buy-points::after{content:"Choose your plan";grid-column:1/-1;margin-top:26px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;font-size:20px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:var(--mc-ink-alt,#242223);
  background:linear-gradient(var(--mc-ink-alt,#242223),var(--mc-ink-alt,#242223)) left center/calc(50% - 110px) 2px no-repeat,linear-gradient(var(--mc-ink-alt,#242223),var(--mc-ink-alt,#242223)) right center/calc(50% - 110px) 2px no-repeat;justify-content:center}

/* ---- Plans: one box per plan; clicking a box selects it and expands it ---- */
html body .mc .mc__plans{margin-top:16px;padding:0;border-radius:0;background:none;box-shadow:none;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none;backdrop-filter:none;overflow:visible;display:flex;flex-direction:column}

/* Skio order is monthly (1) then quarterly (2); quarterly leads. The selected plan's detail and
   the gift area (which the section fills for the selected plan) sit inside that plan's box. */
html body .mc .mc__plans > label.mc__plan:nth-of-type(2){order:2;margin-top:0}
html body .mc .mc__plans > .mc__plan-detail[data-mc-plan-for="2"]{order:3}

html body .mc .mc__plans > label.mc__plan:nth-of-type(1){order:5;margin-top:14px}

html body .mc .mc__plan{padding:18px 18px 16px;border:0;border-radius:14px;background:#fff;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #242223}
html body .mc .mc__plan + .mc__plan{padding-top:18px;border-top:0}
html body .mc .mc__plans > label.mc__plan:nth-of-type(2){border-radius:0 0 14px 14px;box-shadow:inset 1px 0 0 #242223,inset -1px 0 0 #242223,inset 0 -1px 0 #242223}

html body .mc .mc__onetime{display:block;width:100%;margin-top:14px;padding:16px 20px;border:1px solid rgba(36,34,35,.2);border-radius:14px;background:#fff;text-align:left;text-decoration:none;font-size:15px;line-height:1.3}

/* Button: old price struck through, then the price ("Subscribe · £70 £60") */
html body .mc .mc-art__cta-was{font-weight:500;opacity:.55;text-decoration:line-through}

html body .mc .mc-bf{margin:18px 0 0;padding:16px 18px 16px;border:1.5px solid #242223;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;color:#242223;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:4px 16px;align-items:start}

/* ---- Plan cards, AG1-style: per-month price, % off tag in the top-left corner, Best value bar ---- */
/* Skio still bills £150 every 3 months and £60 every 4 weeks. The section prints Skio's price and
   compare-at, so the per-month figures are drawn here and Skio's are hidden (still in the DOM, so the
   button keeps reading the billed price). Card 1 = monthly, card 2 = quarterly (Skio's order). */
html body .mc .mc__plans > label.mc__plan{padding-top:44px}
html body .mc .mc__plan-save{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;height:28px;margin:0;padding:0 12px;border-radius:14px 0 10px 0;

settings.body:
Your body’s changed. Your supplements haven’t. At 20 you could run on a coffee and a late night and still have something left by the evening. Now the afternoon dip arrives on schedule, and a busy week stays in your legs a little longer than it used to.

None of that means slowing down. It means your foundations need a little more looking after. NAD+ Cellular Complex was built for exactly that: one formula for the body you have now, not the one you had at 20.

Who it’s for

Active adults with plenty still to do, at work, at home and in the things you love. You don’t need to be sporty, and you don’t need a wearable.

settings.image_alt: NAD+ Cellular Complex label showing every dose
settings.body:
Turn over most supplement tubs and look for the doses. Often you won’t find them. A “proprietary blend” lists the ingredients but keeps the amounts to itself, so a big-name ingredient on the front can be there in any quantity at all.

Then there’s the cupboard. A multivitamin here, a magnesium there, something an influencer swore by. Six bottles, no plan, and no way of knowing whether they add up to anything.

It’s legal. It’s also why so many people have stopped believing the label.

Read the label before you believe it

Three questions are worth asking of any supplement: does it tell you every dose, has every batch been tested, and can you see the results? Most can’t answer yes to all three.
settings.pull: If a label won’t show you the dose, ask why.

settings.title: Created by a scientist. Reviewed by our scientific board.
settings.image_alt: Dr Richie Barclay, MUTO’s founder, speaking on a panel at the MUTO x NSPCC event
settings.body:
NAD+ Cellular Complex wasn’t put together by a marketing team. It was created by a scientist, our founder Dr Richie Barclay, who wanted a daily formula he could check every word of.

Every ingredient and every dose is then reviewed by our scientific board of doctors and scientists, including Dr James Morehen, performance nutritionist in international rugby, Dr Alka Patel, longevity doctor, and Dr Richard Mackenzie, a leading metabolism researcher.

The law asks very little of supplements. We ask more of ourselves.

So our answer to every question in reason 2 is yes, and you can check each one yourself.

  • Every dose on the label. All 19 ingredients, in two capsules. No proprietary blends.
  • Every batch independently tested for identity, potency, heavy metals and microbes, with the certificates online.
  • Made in the UK in a GMP- and ISO-certified facility. No fillers, no stimulants, and vegan.
  • A UK clinical trial with the University of Westminster, our first, starts this December.
settings.pull: Most supplements ask you to trust them. We’d rather show you.

settings.title: Energy for today. Recovery for tomorrow.
settings.image_alt: A mother and her young daughter sitting outdoors on a windy day, the girl eating an apple, a flask beside them
settings.body:
The two things people over 35 tell us they miss most: an afternoon that doesn’t fade, and a body that’s ready again by the next session, the next school run, the next early start.

  • Energy for today. Vitamins B2, B3, B6, B12 and folate, in doses you can read on the label, for afternoons that hold.
  • Recovery for tomorrow. Vitamin D for normal muscle function, so a hard week doesn’t linger.
settings.claim: Vitamins B2, B3, B6, B12 and folate contribute to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue. Vitamin D contributes to normal muscle function.

settings.heading: Every result came in within its limit.
settings.note: Microbiology by ALS Laboratories (UK) Ltd, heavy metals by M S Laboratories Ltd, both independent UK labs. Where the two batches differed, the higher result is shown. Ask us for the certificates: hello@mutolongevity.com
settings.formula_sub: What went into each capsule of this batch, per two-capsule serving, heaviest first. Vitamins are made with a small overage so the label dose holds right up to the best-before date.
settings.capsule: Capsule: hypromellose (HPMC), made from plant cellulose. Allergen and intolerance free.
settings.why_1: Lead, arsenic, cadmium and mercury can build up in the body over time, and they can come in through plant extracts and minerals. Both batches were tested: lead came in at 0.01 mg/kg against a limit of 3, and mercury and cadmium were below what the lab can measure.
settings.why_2: Bacteria, yeasts and moulds can grow in ingredients that are stored or handled badly. Both batches were screened for six, including salmonella and E. coli. No salmonella was detected, and every other count was 20 per gram or under.
settings.why_3: Microbiology was tested by ALS Laboratories (UK) Ltd and heavy metals by M S Laboratories Ltd, both independent UK laboratories. Every result here is copied from their certificates, listed with their numbers on the overview.
settings.why_4_h: Every batch, not just the first
settings.why_4: A new batch gets a new certificate. We’ll update these results each time, and your batch number is on the jar.
